# RBC / Royal Bank of Canada — Canada

Verified 2026-10-11. Publisher: commercial-bank.

**Documented market:** Canadian RBC Express viewing/export of incoming SWIFT CAMT statements and advices; distinct from U.S. RBC Clear and not a universal bank-originated Canadian reporting claim.

**Formats / versions:** camt.052; camt.053; camt.054

## Official resources

- [RBC Express SWIFT Payments & Statements Import/Export File Guide, March 2023](https://www.rbcroyalbank.com/rbcexpress/rbc-express-sps-import-export.pdf) — availability; public-file
- [Canadian business FAQ: CAMT .053/.052/.054 reporting files](https://www.rbcroyalbank.com/dms/enterprise/national-day-truth-reconciliation-faqs.html) — availability; public-page

## Scope and source notes

Public March 2023 RBC Express guide lists incoming camt.052/053 statements and camt.054 debit/credit advices; The guide establishes viewing/export of received messages, not bank-originated reporting for every Canadian account. Canadian business FAQ also names .053/.052/.054 transmission reporting. Exact schema versions are unstated in these Canadian sources. Sample TXT filenames are listed, but prior PDF extraction found no embedded files or sample hyperlinks; no retrievable public original XML established. Do not apply U.S. RBC Clear versions or delivery channels to Canadian accounts. Account/channel entitlement requires bank confirmation; no open redistribution license established.

[Publisher usage terms](https://www.rbc.com/legal/).
